hypothesis: The default 0.05 path-gradient ratio may be too weak for the PIMPLE supervision to affect the adapted model; stronger ratios may help if the selected solver signal is useful.
fixed_source: The same frozen rotation-augmented selected_pimple_path source checkpoint used in the prior F5 target adaptation screen.
target_support: The same four LR support trajectories per task.
target_validation: The same six LR validation trajectories per task; checkpoint selection remains LR-only.

arms.final_only: Existing frozen final-only target adaptation checkpoint from the rotation source run.
arms.selected_pimple_path: BL-RPNG safe objective with selected PIMPLE correction and path-gradient ratios 0.20 and 0.50.
arms.matched_endpoint_control: Same objective and ratios, replacing the selected path correction by endpoint direction scaled to the selected correction norm.

development_gate: After all checkpoints are frozen, evaluate both ratios on the four existing F5 HR development queries. Promote a ratio to new F6 confirmation only if the PIMPLE-path arm beats both the same-ratio matched control and final-only by at least 1% in mean, and is no worse than either control on each F5 task.
prohibitions: No F6 HR query fields may be read for this experiment, including V1 or V2 queries.
Do not change the registered ratios, architecture, optimizer, or decision rule after training begins.
F5 HR results are development only; any paper claim requires new independently generated F6 HR queries.
